answer: The shale schedule is applied in anchor and juniper exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2185 identities would post 2442 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
